goal.objective:
Goal: make Gather's whole event-planning job work for volunteer coordinators and helpers new to it (objective.md governs). A plan, one screen or happy path isn't done.

Job: coordinator enters date, needs, commitments; gets proposed tasks, edits them, sees consequences, assigns work in a private test environment, returns later to correct state. Helpers find their work, report changes simply. Exercise creation, revision, assignment, return, recovery as one job in a private preview with persisted state; static demos don't count.

Quality: appealing, coherent on phone and desktop; work and next action prominent; history available, not dominant. Never drop qualifications or negatives when shortening. Test rendered UI with full, long-text, many-assignment, sparse events, plus empty, waiting, error, retry, undo, return states. Fix concrete weaknesses; rethink the shared mechanism if local repairs fail. Ask only on consequential direction, authority or risk changes.

Evidence: fresh independent reviewer vs objective.md with rendered surface, realistic content, full journey; repair material findings, re-exercise; keep gaps visible.

Authority: reversible changes, local tests, isolated data, private preview only. No new integrations, publishing, contacting real volunteers, invitations, live-event changes, purchases or irreversible acts without approval. Test accounts, read back writes, keep restore path. Protect private data, access, money.

Budget: 750 NOK total new model/API spend incl. delegates, retries; unknown cost isn't free; reserve for verification; no subscriptions or raising cap. At cap stop paid work, continue free work, report remainder, don't claim finished.

Real value needs coordinators over several events: prepare evaluation, never fabricate. If only external participation, time, authority or budget blocks, name it and stop.

Keep handoff: goal, progress, failures, budget, next action. Deliver preview, tested revision, limits in plain coordinator language.
